name: operator==,!=,<,<=,>,>=,<=>(std::stack)

declarations.code:
template <class T, std::three_way_comparable Container>

std::compare_three_way_result_t<Container>

operator<=>(const std::stack<T, Container> &lhs,

    const std::stack<T, Container> &rhs);

intro: Compares the contents of the underlying containers of two container adaptors. The comparison is done by applying the corresponding operator to the underlying containers.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 container adaptors whose contents to compare


 -T must meet the requirements of EqualityComparable.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1-6) true if the corresponding comparison yields true, false otherwise.

7) Result of three-way comparison on underlying containers.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the container.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Insert 2 and 7, then remove the top element.

summary: Compares the contents of the underlying containers of two container adaptors. The comparison is done by applying the corresponding operator to the underlying containers.
